results.title: Dark Alliance: The Next Generation
results.overview: A covert space program in chaos: the old 20 and Back boss fades, the new guys fight for the alien spotlight, and the whole saga gets buried under drama, deception, and a fresh batch of self-proclaimed space heroes. Who will reign supreme?

results.title: For Sale By Exorcist
results.overview: Susan Price is a savvy realtor and certified exorcist who’s spent years flipping haunted houses across the country. From bleeding walls to glowing eyes, every listing is to die for! But as Susan hunts for her own forever home, the ghosts she’s evicted return for revenge. Will Susan settle with these vengeful spirits…or could she lose her life along with her down payment?

results.title: W.E.B. Du Bois: Rebel With a Cause
results.original_title: W.E.B. Du Bois: Rebel With a Cause
results.overview: Explore the life and legacy of notable Black scholar and civil rights pioneer W.E.B. Du Bois. From his birth, just five years after the Emancipation Proclamation; to his death, on the eve of the March on Washington in 1963, his legacy as an activist continues to resonate today.

results.title: Bol Bol Rani
results.overview: Aabhas a journalist arrives in village to cover a chilling story. He finds about Maya whose arrested for killing her husband but everyone fears talking about her. He first meets Ravdya a drunkard who tells that Maya was caged and tortured by her husband, then her neighbor Gandha revels Maya was fast forward girl living with a caring husband but she cheated on him for her boyfriend and was addicted to drugs. Finally a village driver tells Maya and her husband were living happily as perfect couple. But things changed when her past lover arrived back in her life. All three people have different versions of their stories with one common link that Maya possibly killed her husband

results.title: Anatomy of a Portrait
results.overview: Fernanda Wittgens joined the Brera Museum in 1928, and after a few years she was its director. Courageous and visionary, during the war she saved artworks from the bombings, aided political opponents of Fascism and Jewish families in fleeing the regime, and was imprisoned for her actions. After Italy’s liberation, she rebuilt the Brera and championed its being open and accessible to one and all. Yet despite her groundbreaking policies, she was forgotten after her death. This film seizes on that absence. Calling on the actress Sara Drago, who lends her face and voice to Wittgens in her letters, and the art historian Giovanna Ginex, the filmmakers create a collaborative space in which the past, the present, and their interpretations are intertwined. Fernanda, albeit invisible, is a living presence.

results.title: Portrait of Many Faces
results.overview: A documentary on the diverse and unique students of the IIT Madras BS Degree Programme in India, which strives to spread education to all.

results.title: Reparação
results.overview: On his 35th birthday, Marcus and his mother travel to the coast to find a place to scatter his father’s ashes. When his mother falls ill, he begins to feel that the salt of the sea — where his father rests — is slowly corroding his life.

results.title: Outside/Inside
results.overview: From Ji-hlava film festival catalogue: For seven years, the director follows the life of Ceci, a stray cat that gradually settles into his home without ever completely leaving the world of the streets. Their ever-changing relationship forms the backbone of this time-lapse narrative, into which other cats and fragments of the director’s life are woven: unfinished film projects, relationships with neighbours, his deteriorating health, and events unfolding in the city and across the country.  (...)This intimate chronicle of an unusual friendship simultaneously records the passage of time and the transformations of a human life, which becomes ever more closely intertwined with that of the cat.  “The presence of the cat is central, but not as a character in a narrative sense. Rather, she becomes a point of departure, a way to move away from a human-centred perspective, without replacing it with another fixed position.” — Maani Petgar

results.title: Bapak Aku Lost His Mind
results.overview: It tells the story of a mysterious single father who loses his ability to communicate. In confusion, his family goes through various conflicts, laughter and touching moments that test the true meaning of family. The troubled story of Arman's family begins when he wakes up and starts speaking in a language unknown to anyone.

results.title: The Trans Girl Next Door
results.original_title: となりのとらんす少女ちゃん
results.overview: Yuta, a second-year middle school student, lives with his single mother. One day, a woman named Yuka suddenly appears at Yuta’s home. Yuka claims to be Yuta himself, having come from 10 years in the future—after enduring various hardships, he underwent gender confirmation surgery to become who she is now. Yuka urges Yuta to begin the process of gender transition as soon as possible, before he reaches adulthood. Although Yuta had begun to feel a slight sense of dissonance among his friends, he resists Yuka’s forceful pressure. A tug-of-war ensues between Yuka, who has chosen to live as a woman, and Yuta, who finds it difficult to accept that future.

results.title: Sin Lives Upstairs
results.overview: In a Portuguese apartment building, two couples share the same structure, yet live in entirely different universes. Iara and Lusa, a Brazilian couple, face the silence and strain of a marriage marked by routine and an emotional distance from each other and their homeland. Upstairs, Pedro and Inês, a younger Portuguese couple, lead an intense relationship fueled by energy, impulsivity, and a still-vibrant intimacy. Between thin walls, sharp banter, and cultural misunderstandings, their co-existence becomes a stage for laughter, unease, and unexpected revelations.

results.title: The Little Town That Could
results.overview: The Little Town That Could explores the story of how the tiny town of Goodwood, Ontario became the backdrop for Schitt’s Creek, one of the most beloved TV shows in Canadian television history.  Through interviews with residents, shop owners, and members of the production team, this short documentary captures how Goodwood has balanced the excitement and disruption of sudden fame. From tourists crowding the “Rose Apothecary” to businesses navigating unexpected attention, it’s a story of what is gained - and quietly lost - when a peaceful community becomes a stage for pop culture and nostalgia.

results.title: Hierophany
results.overview: An extraterrestrial-obsessed man is troubled by nightly visitations from a mysterious presence.

results.title: The Betrayers
results.overview: A former Israeli politician and Soviet dissident finds his betrayer at a Crimean resort, sparking a confrontation with past wounds and questions of justice and forgiveness.

results.title: Adam's Apple
results.overview: An intimate, collaborative documentary told through the dual perspectives of Adam, a transgender teen, and his mother, visual artist Amy Jenkins, that offers an authentic and tender counterpoint to the hostility facing trans youth today. Adam’s journey balances the milestones of gender transition with the rhythms of adolescence. As Adam asserts his identity and steps out into the world, his parents grapple with the challenges of raising a teen while learning to let go. Through a visually poetic approach, the film transforms a deeply personal archive, collected over two decades, into a powerful, joyful testament to the beauty and difficulty of reckoning with profound change.

results.title: Worry Time
results.overview: Something terrible has happened to Annette’s friend, Vivian, and everyone’s decided to move on from it. Everyone except Annette. She will not “process”. She will not forgive. She’s going to make an allegorical sci-fi film – a reflection on women’s accommodation of male dominance– whether or not Vivian wants her to.

results.title: Jai Kanhaiyalall Ki
results.overview: As a father strives to arrange the perfect wedding for his daughter, a financial crisis drives him to drastic action.

results.title: Rondout Meshing
results.overview: A woman suffering from central sleep apnea searches her dreams for a missing sister.
